start: ^Alex lies on his stomach on the bed, holding his phone to his eyes. Bluish light filters over his face as he presses his index finger on the screen again and again.
^It's 4.38 in the morning and Alex has to get up for school in a few hours.
^His breath catches, his pupils widen. He doesn't want to stop.

^In his skull, neurons are hungry. They feed on chemicals in the warm fluid soup and thread their tendrils, twitching, seeking. Something is going wrong. Something is warping. They're hungrier than they should be.
